text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hm? There's no one around… I could've sworn I heard someone calling me just now, though…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh, maybe it was the Three Goddesses that called me! There are lots of folk songs that sing about that kinda stuff.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hellooo! Is there something you needed me for?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: If there's anything I can help with, feel free to ask!
